title: Funkel Labs: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Two-Drum Riso. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Two-Drum Riso
options.lineage: Tokyo small-press risograph studios and print fairs
options.thesis: Every shipped product is a print run: two inks, registered by hand, made to be handed over.
materials: uncoated stock, blue + fluorescent pink drums, purple where they cross, grain
Cabinet Grotesk 800 / Literata; JA: Dela Gothic One heads, Zen Kaku Gothic New body
three.js spark rendered as a two-drum halftone shader, slightly out of register
options.viewport: Huge blue headline on bright stock, the 3D spark printing itself in pink and blue separations beside it, pink 'Get in touch' button.
options.risk: Light ground reverses the earlier 'dark' pick, and app screenshots must stay full-colour so the work is not muddied.

raised.raise: One focal object in the hero: the spark alone, nothing laid over it.
The page prints in order: 'How we work' shows the blue plate, the pink plate, then the registered sheet.
Form states print themselves as stamped lines in the drum, not toast chrome.
One strict 8px drum grid governs every measure.

options.label: Station Signage
options.lineage: Japanese railway wayfinding, natively bilingual EN/JA
options.thesis: Your product's route from idea to launch, signed like a train line every visitor already reads.
materials: navy signboards, white type, one line colour per service, station-number roundels
Overpass / BIZ UDPGothic (Morisawa UD, a signage face) for both languages
three.js spark as the line's terminus marker, a train of particles running the route on scroll
options.viewport: A station board: 'Funkel Labs' with 'ファンケル・ラボ' beneath, a green line running Discover → Launch across the screen, 'Get in touch' as the next departure.
options.risk: Can tip into transit costume; the line metaphor must carry real content, not decorate it.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: The apps you built are live tiles; type is the whole interface.
materials: flat colour tiles on black, no gradients or chrome
Murecho Light, giant lowercase cropped off the edge (covers JA too)
tiles flip to app screenshots; the spark is a lime tile
options.viewport: Giant lowercase 'we build software' cropped off the right edge over a strip of app tiles.
options.case: Holds clarity (apps as tiles is the showcase), loses audience identification: reads 2012 Microsoft.
options.risk: Nostalgia for a dead platform; needs strict grid discipline.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.lineage: Noguchi Akari lamps: washi over bamboo, shipped flat
options.thesis: Software that ships flat and lights up when switched on.
materials: glowing washi ground, bamboo rib lines, charcoal ink, one vermilion stamp
Albert Sans Light / Zen Kaku Gothic New; the spark glyph as a hanko stamp
three.js paper lantern lit from inside, the spark is the bulb
options.viewport: A dim room with one paper lantern glowing; headline in charcoal, vermilion stamp as the action.
options.case: Strong identification for Japanese clients, weaker clarity: a lamp does not say 'software'.
options.risk: Calm and crafted, but can read as a lifestyle brand rather than an engineering studio.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.thesis: A glowing disk around an unmarked centre.
options.viewport: A bright disk folding over a black centre.
options.case: Loses both axes: black + glow is the category default, and nothing says software studio.
options.kept: One focal object with nothing laid over it.

options.label: Sampler Proof
options.thesis: Skill visibly developing top to bottom.
options.case: Loses both axes for a software buyer.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The studio as a live terminal transcript.
options.case: Loses both: tool costume, and founders are not terminal users.
options.kept: System states print themselves instead of appearing as chrome.

options.label: ANSI Nightboard
options.viewport: Title art pouring in at modem speed.
options.case: Loses both: retro novelty, unclear offer.
options.kept: A single strict grid unit as the only geometry.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark studio page, one neon accent, glowing 3D object, executed impeccably (the round-2 plan).
materials: Space Grotesk / Inter / JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans JP
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, glowing 3D spark right, lime button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most dev-studio sites by design.
